items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: And yet, when Burgess decided to leave, we felt that Jim would be worth a try on lead. And this evidently was the move that he needed and it turned out to be utterly fantastic.

ctx.x: And he has a guy standing next to him by the name of Jim -- let's see if I get this one right -- Jim -- oh, he's from the Midwest or someplace. Powers, Jim Powers.
